messages:
Jordan Reyes: hey team, on my first day trying to `kubectl get pods -n dev` and I get Forbidden. followed the onboarding kubeconfig steps but we have multiple contexts. any quick sanity checks? /cc @DevEx

DevEx: welcome Jordan! can you paste `kubectl config current-context` and the exact error? also check `echo $KUBECONFIG` in case you have a merged file.

Jordan Reyes: current-context: `redwood-dev`
error:
```
Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User \"user:jordan@redwood.com\" cannot list resource \"pods\" in API group \"\" in the namespace \"dev\"
```
KUBECONFIG unset, defaulting to ~/.kube/config. I also ran `kubectl config view --minify --flatten` and it shows user: `idp:jordan@redwood.com`.

Samir Patel: two quick possibilities: (A) Okta group binding not applied yet (new hires sometimes miss `redwood:team-dev`) OR (B) your kubeconfig context might point to a stale user entry (we rotate OIDC tokens). try `kubectl config view --raw` and look for duplicate users or long expired tokens. Also check `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n dev` (should be "no" for now).

Jordan Reyes: `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n dev` -> "no". I inspected `~/.kube/config` and there's an older user entry `idp:j.reyes@redwood.com` plus the new `idp:jordan@redwood.com`. maybe merging from an older laptop.

DevEx: easiest paths: 1) People Ops/Okta add you to `redwood:team-dev` (canonical flow), or 2) InfraOps can apply a temporary RoleBinding to your specific user while groups sync. also cleaning up the kubeconfig to remove the old user entry helps avoid surprises. recommended command to remove a user entry: `kubectl config unset users."idp:j.reyes@redwood.com"` and then verify `kubectl config current-context` still points to the correct user.

Jordan Reyes: filed the access request via the onboarding form (ticket 6140).

InfraOps: we can put a temp RoleBinding in `dev`. example we apply (infra will revoke after confirmation):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: onboarding-jordan-temp
  namespace: dev
subjects:
- kind: User
  name: "user:jordan@redwood.com"
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: dev-developer
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
Applying now.

Onboard Bot: access request 6140 status updated -> infra temp-binding applied.

Jordan Reyes: confirmed after infra applied it: `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n dev` -> "yes" and `kubectl get pods -n dev` shows the pod list. thanks!! :tada:

People Ops: following up to add you to `redwood:team-dev` so we can remove the temporary binding. expect group sync within 24 hours.

DevEx: thanks for the debug notes Jordan — we'll add a troubleshooting bullet to the quickstart: check `$KUBECONFIG` (or `~/.kube/config`), `kubectl config view --minify` to see which user a context maps to, and the `kubectl config unset users."<old-user>"` tip to clean merged configs. also include the temp RoleBinding snippet. PR incoming. :thumbsup:
